title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass, Carolina Collection (Traditional) Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass in the Carolina Collection—an elegant choice for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Carolina Collection design for a coordinated, matching Carolina bath accessory set
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Wall mount installation helps save floor space
- Installation hardware included (towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware)

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Product length: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Projection: 2 in
- Product height: 3.5 in; product width: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Material: Brass; straight bar
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finishes: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement finish options like pink, lavender, spanish gold, mediterranean blue, and glokzin teal.
